authFailing.title: inFakt deliveries are being rejected

infaktWebhookConfig.intro: inFakt signs each delivery and mints the secret itself, so OpenLinker can't register the webhook for you. Register the endpoint in inFakt, then paste the secret it shows you.

overwrite.description: This breaks deliveries until inFakt is updated to match.
overwrite.title: Replace signing secret?

infaktWebhookConfig.registerHint: Create the webhook, then open its details and click Weryfikuj (status Do weryfikacji → Aktywny). inFakt POSTs a verification_code; OpenLinker echoes it back automatically.

save.error: Could not save the signing secret
save.toastDescription: OpenLinker will now verify inFakt delivery signatures.

secret.hint: A signing secret is required for OpenLinker to accept deliveries: open the webhook's details in inFakt → Sekretny klucz do HMAC and paste that value here. OpenLinker then verifies X-Infakt-Signature and rejects mismatches with 401.
secret.label: Signing secret

why.body: inFakt has no webhook-provisioning API and its form has no secret field: it generates one per subscription, shown only in that subscription's details. So the secret can only travel inFakt → OpenLinker. Don't rotate the secret from OpenLinker: that mints a new server-side value inFakt would never know, breaking every delivery.
why.summary: Why can't OpenLinker set this up for me?

infaktWebhookConnectionActions.description: Deliver KSeF clearance events from inFakt in real time. Register the endpoint and, optionally, verify delivery signatures.
infaktWebhookConnectionActions.title: Webhook setup

infaktWebhookSecretSchema.tooLong: Secret must be at most 512 characters
